1.consolidated_definition: En las peleas de gallos, ojo de un gallo de pelea que ha perdido su fondo, y que, por lo tanto, le ha desaparecido el color de la pupila.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In cockfighting, the eye of a fighting rooster that has lost its comb, and as a result, has lost the color of the pupil.
